audit.why: Poppy-comfortable early-to-mid with K'Sante scaling past her fits the 54.85% win rate over 1001 games, and the whys and phase text agree row by row. The packet chart disagrees on rows 1, 2, 3 and 5, but the audited ksante__poppy mirror deliberately made no row flips, so flipping here would introduce a contradiction rather than remove one.
audit.corrected: No row changes. Raised as a question instead.

audit.why: Four spikes present and correctly owned: levels 2-3 wall window, level 6 All Out, first item forcing window, late K'Sante scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: Path Maker is described only as a 'W block' that negates the slam. Riot's text says K'Sante charges up taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning — so E-ing him during the charge does not get blocked, it gets you stunned and displaced. The page also never mentions Footwork's shield, never mentions that Ntofo Strikes fires a pull at 2 stacks, and never warns that either CC cancels Keeper's Verdict's channel.
audit.why: A player told 'his W blocks your slam' will dash into a charged Path Maker expecting a whiff and eat a stun instead. And Poppy's R is a channel: with two Ntofo stacks loaded on a 3.5s cooldown, opening R is throwing it.
audit.corrected: Path Maker named with its charge-then-stun-and-knockback reality and 14/13/12/11/10s cooldown; Footwork named as the 10s shield dash to force out before committing; the 2-stack Ntofo pull named as what cancels Keeper's Verdict; W-Steadfast Presence pointed at Footwork and Path Maker, which are the actual dashes.

audit.why: report[8] already carries early anti-heal against All Out's healing, and Path Maker's true damage means armour stacking is not the whole answer — the existing build line leads on Iceborn Gauntlet and HP rather than pure armour, so nothing is misleading.

edits.before: W deletes his dash mid-flight — hold it like a parry. Only take the trade when K'Sante's All Out is down.
edits.after: W stops Footwork and Path Maker mid-dash. Don't E him while he charges W — that release stuns and knocks you back.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around All Out's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Force out Footwork's shield, back every 10s, before you commit — and never open Keeper's Verdict while his Q stacks are loaded.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — K'Sante's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: All Out strips his own resists, but the cast first launches you through a wall. Trade before 6; once it is up, fight with your jungler.

edits.before: K'Sante wastes All Out — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Two Ntofo Strikes stacks fire a pull — that cancels your R.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Path Maker's charge-up cuts the damage he takes, then its dash stuns and knocks you back.

edits.before: Even fight: you have Q+E for a wall-stun but his W block and tankiness let him eat it if he times the cooldown.
edits.after: Even fight: you have Q+E for a wall-stun, but Path Maker's charge eats the damage and its dash stuns you on release.

edits.before: Land E into a wall for the unconditional stun while his W block is on cooldown
edits.after: Land E into a wall for the stun while Path Maker's 14s charge-stun is down

edits.before: Bait your W out, then commit his dash so the dash-deny is wasted
edits.after: Bait your W, then Footwork in behind a shield with the deny wasted

notes: Poppy is called 'he/his/him' in tradeBad, dontsFull[0].d, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.carry and report[9]/[12] — the ksante__poppy mirror flagged the same thing and neither of us had a length-safe rewrite that also added information. Needs a champion-level pronoun sweep. Not asserted anywhere: that Keeper's Verdict makes Poppy untargetable during the channel (derived flag only, absent from Riot's text). dosFull[2].t 'Dodge his Q knockups' and dontsFull[0].t 'Get walled by his Q' are both wrong — Ntofo Strikes pulls in, it does not knock up, and it is All Out that launches through walls — but both are under 25 characters so the applier skips them.
